segments.he: הִיא גּוּפַהּ קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן, דְּחִינּוּךְ וְקִידּוּשׁ דְּשֻׁלְחָן בְּשַׁבָּת הוּא, כִּדְקָתָנֵי סֵיפָא: וְלֹא אֶת הַמְּנוֹרָה אֶלָּא בְּשִׁבְעָה נֵרוֹתֶיהָ בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם.
segments.en: The Gemara answers: The mishna «teaches us this» halakha «itself, that the initiation» of the use of a new Table «and the sanctification of» the shewbread when it is placed on «the Table» occur only «on Shabbat.» This is «as» the mishna «teaches» in «the latter clause» with regard to the initiation of the use of a new Candelabrum: «And» use of a new «Candelabrum» was initiated «only with» the kindling «of its seven lamps in the afternoon.»

moves.summary: that is exactly the mishna's point
moves.about: the mishna teaches that both initiation of the table and sanctification of the bread occur only on Shabbat

moves.summary: as with the menorah in the latter clause

edges.about: the mishna teaches that both initiation of the table and sanctification of the bread occur only on Shabbat

positions.claim: initiation of the table and sanctification of the shewbread both occur only on Shabbat
positions.basis: parallel to the menorah clause of the mishna
